command:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; Write-Output ('FREDWIN_HOST=' + $env:COMPUTERNAME); $ssh=(Get-Command ssh -ErrorAction Stop).Source; Write-Output ('SSH_PATH=' + $ssh); & $ssh -V 2>&1 | Select-Object -First 1; $remote=@'
set -u
printf 'REMOTE_HOST='; hostname
printf 'REMOTE_USER='; whoami
printf 'DEPLOY='; if test -d /home/ubuntu/shopvivaliz-deploy/current; then echo OK; else echo MISSING; fi
printf 'RELEASE='; readlink -f /home/ubuntu/shopvivaliz-deploy/current || true
printf 'PHP='; php -r 'echo PHP_VERSION, PHP_EOL;' 2>/dev/null || true
for u in 'https://shopvivaliz.com.br/' 'https://shopvivaliz.com.br/catalogo' 'https://shopvivaliz.com.br/catalogo?q=antique' 'https://shopvivaliz.com.br/catalogo?q=decore'; do curl -L -sS -o /dev/null --connect-timeout 10 --max-time 30 -w "URL=%{url_effective}|HTTP=%{http_code}|TIME=%{time_total}\n" "$u" || echo "URL=$u|CURL=FAILED"; done
'@; & $ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=15 shopvivaliz-vm $remote; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw 'Fred-Win relay or shopvivaliz-vm SSH failed'}
reason: Validate Fred-Win terminal relay, canonical SSH alias, deploy path, PHP runtime, and critical storefront URLs without exposing secrets
